purpose: Operational prioritization for Project 4 closure queue only. This is not a company-wide SLA standard and does not override project or standard-owner governance.

P1.description: Material migration gap requiring project implementation.

P2.description: Discovery or evidence work required before implementation.

aging_states.AT_RISK: At or above warning threshold but below SLA.

rules: Aging is measured from the handoff audit timestamp because v1 handoffs do not carry a separate issued_at field.
A refreshed handoff resets the aging basis to the refreshed audit timestamp.
Completion reports stop project-work aging only for tasks reported DONE or NOT_APPLICABLE; audit closure is still tracked separately.
CLOSED_VERIFIED stops all Project 4 aging for the closed task.
SLA breach is an operational signal only; it does not authorize project writes, merges, escalation actions, deployment or production mutation.
